rationale: The Laravel variant now has a real application-local ReleaseNotesService::getAll() contract matching the canonical source read behavior: versioned Markdown headings are parsed into release records, dash/star change lines are preserved, repeated reads may reuse an unchanged non-empty mtime cache, missing files return a truthful empty collection, and an existing-but-unreadable file fails rather than fabricating an empty success.

runtime_behavior.format: Markdown ## release headings with -/* change bullets
runtime_behavior.cache: non-empty result reused only while file mtime is unchanged

acceptance: canonical operation AIMW-PLAT-15C5517022 remains the only operation claimed by this evidence
missing release-notes source returns an empty collection without sample or fabricated history
canonical version/date/title and dash/star change syntax is parsed deterministically
fallback headings preserve their version text and get the source-equivalent default title
invalid dates do not fabricate a date
an unchanged non-empty file may use the cached parsed result
mtime changes cause authoritative reread and reparse
file removal cannot return stale cached releases
scope_exclusions: release-history content invention or source-product modification
